targets.outcome_robustness_quote: The Javanmard and Montanari method exhibited the highest precision , consistently yielding the narrowest confidence intervals and isolating signal where the Ridge and Lasso projection estimators were less sensitive. These results highlight the substantial precision gains achievable through the optimized de-biasing procedure proposed by Javanmard and Montanari (2014).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The original empirical dataset is reanalysed with alternative estimators, preserving the precision advantage of the original method. Exact recovery of original empirical numerical results is not established. Numerical discrepancies in regenerated simulations do not alone establish computational failure on original data.
